acceptanceCriteria.text: Default PR `runtime-appliance-golden-path` contains no `0.7.0`, `0.7.1`, `nawabariVersion`, historical source SHA, GitHub tag download, or historical application source build.
Exactly two repository-owned Mottainai fixture source trees exist: version `1.0.0` and `2.0.0`.
Fixture packages have no Node/npm/pnpm dependency graph and perform no network access.
Fixture source NAR hashes are verified rather than bypassed.
Golden-path manifests contain exactly one package ID: `mottainai`.
The real managed-generation Nix builder is used.
The real generation identity calculation is used.
The real activation/current symlink path is used.
The real production managed-runtime health check is used.
The real production rollback state machine is used.
Fresh activation, version update, reboot persistence, no-op reconciliation, rollback, unmanaged-state semantics, and canonical appliance immutability retain equivalent assertions.
`mottainai --version` proves `1.0.0` for generation 1 and `2.0.0` for generation 2.
Default PR golden path performs no external historical-release network fetch.
Relaxed sandboxing is removed if historical network fetch was its only requirement.
Current HEAD Node.js 24/Nix package validation remains real and separate from fixtures.
No production source resolver, production CLI fixture mode, manifest schema, or canonical path override is introduced.
Review Pages/OCR for the resulting PR contains the deterministic review package introduced by #704/#707; no special OCR handling is added in this Issue.
